name: office-viewer
description: Zero-dependency Antigravity sidecar plugin that previews local Microsoft Office files (.docx, .xlsx, .pptx) directly in the side pane, with auto-detected one-click handoff to local desktop Office apps.
suggestedPrompts: Preview the latest .docx document in my workspace using Office Viewer
List all Office files (.docx, .xlsx, .pptx) in this project and open one in the side pane
Generate a Word report and open it immediately in Office Viewer
